name: SOF lateral spine radiographs (Study of Osteoporotic Fractures)
what: the women's counterpart of MrOS: lateral thoracolumbar films at several visits, about 9,700 women, Genant grading per vertebra; counts to confirm on the page
level_truth: Genant grades on named levels, so level truth exists
licence: a SOF data request agreement; terms to confirm on the page
how_to_get: Request the lateral spine films through the NIA Aging Research Biobank (https://agingresearchbiobank.nia.nih.gov): log in or create an account there, open Requests, Request for Materials, choose Images at the top of the form and name the SOF study; the biobank's sample agreement and costs pages give the terms and fees, and the request, the agreement and any fee are the owner's hand; the proposal text is letters/sof_lateral_spine.md.
SOF Online itself (https://sofonline.ucsf.edu/) is closed to registrations until its NIH update is done; the centre writes when it reopens, and the reading tables may still come from there.
Once granted, fetch by the route the centre gives, as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node.
